## Customization

### Edit your omikuji freely with "OmikujiBot Editor"

![Screen: "Edit your omikuji freely with OmikujiBot Editor"](../../../images/customization-1792727159845.webp)

- Some distribution packages include **OmikujiBot Editor** (an app for editing omikuji data).
- Open **`editor.html`** in the same folder as the app to launch it.
- For details, see the [OmikujiBot Editor README](/core/ConfigEditor/README.md).
